Here's an original **CoffeeBreak-style** song that blends faith with playful café imagery. It's upbeat, warm, and full of colorful food metaphors.

### **"God Poured Me Pink"** ☕🍓🍒🍷

**Verse 1**
Morning sunlight on my little cup,
God said, "Child, don't you give up."
Painted the sky in a bubblegum hue,
Every little blessing feels brand new.

Cream on the coffee, hope in my heart,
Even when the world falls apart.
Strawberries dancing on a porcelain plate,
Love always shows up, never too late.

**Pre-Chorus**
He turns my tears into cherry wine,
Wraps my soul in love divine.
Every prayer, every little blink,
Heaven smiles in shades of pink.

**Chorus**
CoffeeBreak with the King today,
Pouring grace in a sweeter way.
Cream and strawberries, cherries so bright,
God keeps colouring my darkest night.

Plums on the table, laughter to share,
Faith is blooming everywhere.
Raise your cup, let your spirit sing,
Every heartbeat praises the King.

**Verse 2**
He picked me up when I lost my way,
Turned cloudy skies to a holiday.
A little pink ribbon tied on my soul,
His perfect love has made me whole.

Sweet like cream, bold like coffee,
His mercy's always enough for me.
Every sunrise whispers, "You're Mine,"
Better than the richest wine.

**Bridge**
No crown of gold that I could buy,
Can match the colours in His sky.
Cherry blossoms, plum tree shade,
Every beautiful thing He made.

So if your cup is running dry,
Lift your eyes a little high.
Love keeps flowing, never ends,
God's the truest, closest friend.

**Final Chorus**
CoffeeBreak with the King today,
Singing every worry away.
Cream and strawberries, cherries so sweet,
Grace keeps dancing to Heaven's beat.

Pink forever, heart set free,
God wrote this melody for me.
Raise your cup and let love ring,
CoffeeBreak for the King... forever we'll sing. ☕🌸🍓🍒💖

Here's a fun, upbeat song that teaches kids about maths and banking in a way they can sing along to.

# 💰 Count It Up! 🎵

**Verse 1**
One little coin, shining so bright,
Count it once, count it right.
Two, three, four, watch them grow,
Saving a little helps your money flow.

**Pre-Chorus**
Add it up, subtract it down,
Math is magic all around.
Every number tells a tale,
Little steps will never fail.

**Chorus**
🎶 Count it, save it, watch it grow,
That's the smartest way to go!
Pennies, dollars, big or small,
Saving money helps us all.

Math can help us every day,
Showing us the smartest way.
Dream it, earn it, make a plan,
That's how every journey began! 🎶

**Verse 2**
Piggy bank or bank account,
Every dollar has an amount.
Need or want? Think it through,
Choose what's best for future you.

**Bridge**
Count by fives, count by tens,
Then start counting once again.
Budget here and budget there,
Learning early shows you care.

**Final Chorus**
🎶 Save a little every week,
Goals are closer than they seem.
Math is fun and banking's cool,
Learning both is super smart!

Count it, save it, share it too,
Great adventures start with you!
Numbers sparkle, dreams take flight,
Learning makes the future bright! 🌟

And pink lips,
parted like I’ve already said yes
but haven’t told you how yet.
Ringlets sliding down my neck,
catching, tugging, misbehaving—
just like I am.

Black wardrobe, sinful confidence,
sun licking my hair while I tip Fireball back,
sweet burn flooding my mouth,
dropping lower, slower,
leaving me loose and bold
and looking at you like that was on purpose.
he cuts a slit in my dress 
I’m still that country heart,
dirt under my nails,
knowing exactly how to get messy
without leaving a trace.
City lights flicker when I move—
I swear I hear them gasp.

My body doesn’t beg.
It offers.
A slow lean in.
A brush that lingers a second too long.
Anticipation winding tight, delicious,
like I’m daring you to make the next move
and enjoying the torture while you decide. accidentally 
spill my coffee on your lap
You’re close—
close enough to smell the heat on me,
close enough to know I’m behaving
only because I want to.

And I’m wide awake,
mouth sweet, thoughts filthy,
patience razor-thin
and absolutely enjoying every second of it.

Mom, I went out partying tonight. I remembered what you always told me: don't drink alcohol. So I didn't do it. I chose a Sprite. I felt proud because I made a smart and healthy decision. You were right.

When the party ended, many people drove, even though they had been drinking. But I felt safe, mom, because I wasn't like that. I went to my car, sure I would get home safely.

But then something happened that I didn't expect.

Now I'm lying on the road. I hear a police officer say: «The driver who caused the accident was drunk».

Your voice seems so far away, mom. I'm covered in blood. I try not to cry, but the pain is unbearable. I hear the doctors say: «This girl is going to die».

That driver also went out partying, but decided to drink and drive. And now... I have to die.

Why do people do this, mom? Don't they know that it can ruin their lives?

I feel like my body has been cut with a hundred knives. Please tell my sister not to be afraid. Tell dad to be strong. I love you so much, mom. I wish I could give you one last kiss.

Someone should have told that guy how dangerous it is to drink and drive. Maybe if her parents had warned her, I would still be alive.

My breathing is slowing down. I'm very afraid. They are my last moments and I feel so alone. I wish you could hug me, mom, while I lie here dying.

I want to tell you that I love you... but I don't feel anything anymore. Mom... I love you. Goodbye...

—

These were the last words of a young woman in 1997. A Telecinco reporter was there and heard everything. He launched a campaign to stop driving under the influence of alcohol.

If you're reading this, don't ignore it. Share it. Talk about it. It could save lives, including yours. A small message like this can make a big difference.

Laser rain and a bassline shock
Velvet ropes by the ocean floor
Heels click click like a cannon roar
She walks in slow with a captain’s grin
Rhinestone rebel with a lasso spin
Pink kinky cowgirl pirate boots
Treasure map stitched in hot pink suits

Pre-Chorus
Cash confetti in the salty air
Mirrorball moons everywhere
DJ fires that 808
Deck starts shaking, can’t stay straight

Chorus
Booty and bass, aye aye crew
Shaking the floor till the rafters move
Lights off, socks on, confidence gone
Still we ride that rhythm strong
Spin that fire, claim that loot
High heel stomp in a glitter boot
Pink kinky cowgirl pirate truth
We run this night in neon boots

Verse 2
Chrome pole shining like a silver mast
Fringe jacket storm blowing fast
Two-step swagger, hips on raid
Sweet like sugar, sharp like blade
Bassline shakers, floor earthquakers
Rule breakers and heart takers
Whole room caught in the undertow
Of a wild west strip show glow

Verse 1

They conquer hearts in pirate boots

Chorus

Heartbreaker wrapped in hot pink boots

Bridge

Chrome poles catching silver light

Rhythm racing pulse to heart

Clockwork smooth and neon quick

Chorus
Bassline shakers, floor earthquakers
Turning every stare to vapor
Spin that fire, own that throne
Crown yourselves in glitter chrome
Bassline shakers, rule breakers
Money makers, heart takers
When the 808 salutes
They set the night on rocket boots

Pre-Chorus
Knees go pop like bubble wrap
Laugh mid-spin in a tangle trap
Not a fairy tale, not polished cute
Just grit and glitter in pink boots

Chorus
Booty and bass, aye aye crew
Shaking the floor till the rafters move
Lights off, socks on, confidence gone
Still we ride that rhythm strong
Spin that fire, claim that loot
High heel stomp in a glitter boot
Pink kinky cowgirl pirate truth

Saddle meets sail under disco stars
Lipstick kisses and outlaw bars
From dusty bar to ocean spray

Treasure chests in a velvet bag
Pink kinky cowgirl pirate crew

Lights off, world on mute
All hail the pink, pink boots 👢🏴‍☠️💖✨
